The image preserves the healthy-slight-lanky long-limbed frame, angular face, asymmetric brows, broad cheek planes, small upturned nose, heavy lower lip, auburn braids, repaired ochre-cream tailored longcoat, high collar, split hems, one nape/side-neck tattoo, and polished shoes. However, the complexion reads materially deeper than the declared band-3 light-medium value, and a round chained locket or watch appears in addition to the folded handkerchief, creating a second personal object beyond the intended single cherished detail.
The closed heavy-lower-lip mouth, level gaze, composed asymmetric brows, squared posture, and still hands read calm and neutral without smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

The repaired cloth, plain folded handkerchief, small chained keepsake, tattoo, trousers, and polished shoes remain grounded mortal belongings. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, or text appears.

Although auburn coloring and the tailored longcoat differ, the output carries over the rendering plate’s deeper-skinned angular woman, shaved right-side braid construction, heavy offset braid fall, and closely related facial and three-quarter presentation strongly enough that the fresh identity is not securely distinct from the forbidden reference person, phenotype, braid, and pose.
